newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Peters signals delay to GPS float.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters signals delay to GPS float.

text.p: Treasurer Winston Peters on Thursday signalled the planned float of Government Property Services (GPS) may be delayed.
"Because of lease and other commercial arrangements that may not be able to be done with the speed or expedition we would like," Peters told journalists.
"But I think the signal is very clear. We make it very obvious we don't believe there is any reason for government to own a commercial property company."
GPS has a portfolio of NZ$160 million worth of buildings mostly housing government agencies.
